adaptations: Training session 08 exercise; semantics per the EXSLT 1.0 spec (exslt.org): the full ISO 8601 profile parses (dateTime, date, gYearMonth, gYear, gMonthDay, gMonth, gDay, time), invalid input yields NaN for numeric extractors and '' for string extractors. Companion vehicles of the session: date:leap-year and date:month-name (same parsing ladder; month-name uses the library's repaired format-date '[MNn]' spelling — REQ-008 added the xs:date cast at the call site — and the golden pins the post-repair behavior: October/February/March/January for parseable input, empty for invalid).
